title: EVA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Evaluators for Judging Temporal Quality
abstract: arXiv:2611.23890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video evaluators play an important role in video generation, yet they miss motion defects, limiting the quality of generated videos. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) has made strong progress in mathematics and coding, where explicit verifiers provide reliable feedback on a single goal. Video evaluation poses two difficulties for RSI: it has no verifier, and it must judge many dimensions at once, such as physics, smoothness and dynamics, where a gain on one can cost another. We introduce EVA-RSI, a multi-agent framework for exploring RSI under these two constraints. We build a fixed proxy exam with construction-defined targets by applying controlled changes to videos, such as temporal reversal and frame dropping. These edits supply supervision without human annotation. A small set of human-labeled real videos anchors the exam to human judgment. Each dimension has an LLM agent that proposes improvements. translated_title: EVA-RSI：面向时序质量评判的视频评估器的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 视频评估器在视频生成中扮演着重要角色，但它们常常遗漏运动缺陷，从而限制了生成视频的质量。递归自我改进（RSI）已在数学和编程领域取得显著进展，因为在那里显式验证器可以针对单一目标提供可靠的反馈。视频评估给RSI带来了两大难题：一是没有验证器可用，二是必须同时评判多个维度（如物理性、平滑度和动态性），而其中一个维度的提升可能以牺牲另一个维度为代价。我们提出了EVA-RSI，一个在这两种约束下探索RSI的多智能体框架。我们通过对视频施加受控变化（如时间反转和丢帧），构建了一个具有构造式定义目标的固定代理考试。这些编辑无需人工标注即可提供监督信号。少量人工标注的真实视频将该考试锚定到人类判断上。每个维度由一个LLM智能体提出改进方案，并由一个领导智能体协调各提案……
tldr: 该论文提出EVA-RSI，一个多智能体递归自我改进框架，通过对视频施加受控编辑（如时间反转、丢帧）构造无需人工标注的代理考试，并协调多个LLM智能体分工改进，从而提升视频评估器在物理性、平滑度、动态性等多维度上的时序质量评判能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces EVA-RSI, a multi-agent recursive self-improvement framework that constructs an annotation-free proxy exam via controlled video edits (e.g., temporal reversal and frame dropping), coordinating dimension-specific LLM agents to iteratively improve video evaluators' judgment of temporal quality across physics, smoothness, and dynamics.
